coverage: The little-endian TRANSFER_TO_HOST_2D wire fixture round-trips all fields and the control-queue test echoes a fenced response.
Full and partial copies match the reference across SG boundaries, including an odd-x partial rectangle and a 64x64 frame backed by one-byte entries.

Checked rectangle, offset, stride, row-span, and backing-range arithmetic rejects detached backing, out-of-bounds rectangles, offset u64::MAX, and backing_len - 1 with a two-byte span before shadow mutation.
The randomized model-oracle test executes 10,000 cases under each of three independent seeds (30,000 total) and compares every resulting shadow pixel.
Guest source bytes are snapshotted before and after transfer; no transfer path mutates the backing source. The SG reader advances by contiguous spans and row gaps, not per pixel.
